subject: Access continuity addendum request — Medico pilot
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@medico.io>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@medico.io>
Date: 2027-06-30T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Access continuity addendum request — Medico pilot

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for taking the product deep-dive yesterday — we were glad to see the Medico team get meaningful throughput on the triage workflow. I wanted to check on next steps for procurement so we can keep the pilot live: our records show the PO is in flight but not yet approved.

If procurement needs a short runway to complete approvals, we can provide a 10-day access continuity addendum and a small promotional credit to prevent the pilot from lapsing. That addendum is a simple doc that extends sandbox access and preserves existing rate limits and model pins.

Would a 10-day window and a $500 credit cover you while procurement finishes the PO? If so I’ll route the addendum through our legal/sales ops and send a DocuSign.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0172

Attachments: none
From: Alex Morgan <alex@medico.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-30T11:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Access continuity addendum request — Medico pilot

Irene —

Appreciate the follow-up. Procurement is still stuck on a vendor consolidation check and legal asked for a final review before issuing the PO. Timeline looks like 7–10 business days out right now. We definitely don’t want the pilot to time out — the engineering team is mid-integration and losing the KV cache would force a big rework.

If Redwood can sign a short addendum that keeps the environment live for 10 working days and apply any small promo credit you can, that would be hugely helpful. Can you also put the brief agreement in writing so procurement can see it externally?

Thanks,
Alex Morgan
Head of Engineering, Medico Health
alex@medico.io
Procurement contact: procurement@medico.io
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Cc: (internal)
Date: 2027-06-30T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Medico pilot — request for 10-day addendum and promo credit

Team — forwarding Medico's ask. Summary: procurement PO delayed ~7–10 business days; customer requests a 10-working-day addendum to keep the sandbox live + a small promotional credit to cover the burst during the hold.

Details:
- Customer: Medico Health (Deal DEAL-4892)
- Value: early-stage trial, likely to convert if integration keeps momentum
- Ask: 10 working days of continuity + $500 promotional credit (or equivalent token bucket)

Recommendation: approve the addendum sign-off and up to $500 credit. I’d keep the credit conditional (one-time, non-recurring) and attach the addendum that explicitly states this is to preserve the current pilot environment only. I can draft and send DocuSign.

Can I get quick confirm from Jonas/Marcus? If approved I’ll send the addendum to Alex and copy procurement.

Thanks,
Irene
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-07-01T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Medico pilot — request for 10-day addendum and promo credit

Irene —

Approve. Authorize up to $500 promotional credit and the standard 10-business-day access addendum. Condition the credit on playbook terms (one-time promotional credit; no change to pricing post-pilot). Please include a short paragraph in the addendum noting that this is a temporary measure while procurement completes the PO.

Marcus — FYI; happy to escalate if procurement drags beyond 10 business days.

Jonas
VP, Sales Operations
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@medico.io>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@medico.io>, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-07-02T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Access continuity addendum request — Medico pilot

Alex —

Thanks for the quick note. We’ve approved a 10-business-day access continuity addendum and a one-time $500 promotional credit to keep the pilot live while procurement finalizes the PO.

Next steps:
- I’ve attached the addendum (trial-addendum-Medico-20270630.pdf) — it’s a short one-page agreement that preserves access and model pins for ten business days.
- Please review and sign via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc123-def456
- HubSpot deal for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4892

Once signed we’ll apply the credit and confirm access retention. If procurement expects the delay to exceed 10 business days, let me know and we can reassess (we can extend under exec review).

Appreciate the collaboration — glad the team is seeing value.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai
Phone: (415) 555-0172

Attachments: trial-addendum-Medico-20270630.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
